name: print-social-cyan-square-post-with-two-tone-circle-block-corner
title: Cyan Post with Circle Block Corner
whatItIs: A saturated cyan square post with a small logo, a large white headline 'Our Marketing Drives Your Brand Forward.', a website line at the lower left and a corner block pattern of white and deep-teal squares holding circles and quarter circles, on a pale blue backdrop with a soft shadow.
whatItMeans: Big white type on cyan reads instantly, and the corner pattern adds interest without stealing the message.
techniques: Solid cyan field with white headline
Block pattern anchored to a single corner
Two tones of the same hue for shapes
Small logo top left and site at the base
Drop shadow lifting the post from the backdrop
bestFor: Single-colour templates with a corner motif

vocabulary.definition: A pattern placed in one corner of a canvas.
Shapes coloured in tints of the background hue.
A soft shadow under an object.
